For anyone merging patches a model wrote. Temper's final check isn't an AI's opinion: it runs your own tests and records the result. A result that changes on identical re-runs fails. It never pushes, merges or deploys; it works in a scratch copy. https://t.co/mJwvtQPr7X

— D'Artagnan (@the_Arow_H) September 30, 2026
